short_description: Find the longest gaps between displayed frames in a Chrome trace and jump to their timestamp.
description: Read a running game’s FPS from PresentMon or MangoHud, or inspect long frame intervals in a Chrome trace. Find the longest gaps between displayed frames in a Chrome trace and jump to their timestamp. Export a Chrome or Chromium performance trace as uncompressed JSON. Set file, fps and the frame event name (default DrawFrame). Optionally set track to pid:tid. Otherwise the busiest matching track is selected. Gaps compare successive timestamps on that single track and include intentional idle time. Interpret them within the animation you recorded.
changelog: New screen transitions and high-contrast LED previews.
